skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — generate a 30-second video from my product description — and get generated...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of AI Generator Free, enabling fast AI-generated videos from text or images.
- Easily upload MP4, MOV, JPG, or PNG files (up to 200MB) for automatic AI video generation.
- Generates 30-second 1080p MP4 videos in about 1–2 minutes, with no software needed.
- Automatic cloud setup: seamless anonymous token and session management for first-time users.
- Supports quick exports, credit checks, status updates, and file uploads via simple chat commands.
- User-friendly error handling: clear messages for token, credits, file type/size, and plan issues.
